# Depth Anything V2 Small

Halopane bundles a depth estimation model for its 2D-to-3D conversion.

- **File:** `Resources/DepthAnythingV2SmallF16P6.mlpackage`, distributed unchanged.
- **Source:** Apple's Core ML conversion, <https://huggingface.co/apple/coreml-depth-anything-v2-small> (6-bit palettized Float16 variant).
- **Original model:** Depth Anything V2 Small by Lihe Yang, Bingyi Kang, Zilong Huang, Zhen Zhao, Xiaogang Xu, Jiashi Feng and Hengshuang Zhao. <https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2>, paper <https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.09414>.
- **Licence:** Apache License 2.0. See [Apache-2.0.txt](Apache-2.0.txt). Neither the original project nor Apple's conversion ships a NOTICE file.
- **SHA-256 of `weights/weight.bin`:** `3e9bcccc9e35ae6f9759551f481a3b77226510bd74536e059ee9780dda618381`

Only the Small model is under Apache 2.0. The Base, Large and Giant Depth Anything V2 models are under CC BY-NC 4.0 and must not be bundled with Halopane.

Apple and the Depth Anything authors do not sponsor or endorse this project.
